records.title: Entropy Reveals Block Importance in Masked Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
records.reason: Entropy-based block-importance estimation and block removal are evaluated on masked self-supervised vision Transformers; the technique is related to generic Transformer pruning but has no LLM decoder evaluation.

records.title: DualPhysMamba: Efficient end-to-end network based on noise modeling for remote photoplethysmography measurement
records.reason: The primary-source abstract describes remote physiological signal extraction from facial video with a noise-modeling Mamba network; this is an rPPG application, not LLM inference.

records.title: A multi-step State of Charge prediction method for lithium-ion batteries based on a Dual-stage framework with modified Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory
records.reason: The title identifies battery state-of-charge forecasting with a BiLSTM; it is a domain forecasting application, not LLM inference or a transferable LLM efficiency method.

records.title: OCTOPUS: Enhancing the Spatial-Awareness of Vision SSMs with Multi-Dimensional Scans and Traversal Selection
records.reason: The full paper’s multi-directional scan and traversal selection are for vision SSM image classification/segmentation; no textual SSM or LLM inference experiment is established.

records.title: GeoNorm: Unify Pre-Norm and Post-Norm with Geodesic Optimization
records.reason: GeoNorm changes normalization/update geometry for Transformer training; the inspected work concerns optimization and model quality, with no concrete inference memory/latency/throughput improvement.
